page.content:
The team title awarded since 1958.

How World Constructors' Championship connects

  • Topic: Formula 1 — The Constructors' Championship is Formula 1's team title.
  • Faction: FIA — The FIA awards the World Constructors' Championship.
  • Faction: Mercedes-AMG Petronas — Mercedes won a record hybrid-era run of Constructors' Championships.
  • Faction: Red Bull Racing — Red Bull Racing added constructors' titles in the Vettel and Verstappen eras.
  • Faction: Scuderia Ferrari — Ferrari has treated the Constructors' Championship as a birthright prize.

What is World Constructors' Championship?

The World Constructors' Championship is the FIA title for constructors, the prize Ferrari, McLaren, Mercedes, and Red Bull treat as proof the factory — not only the driver — won the year.

Key threads lead to Formula 1, FIA, Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Red Bull Racing and Scuderia Ferrari.
